description:
5 shot list items most event planners forget. And regret missing when the report is due.

1. Arrival sequence. Guests entering, registration desks, lobby branded signage. This sets atmosphere in post-event reports.
2. Room setup before doors open. The events team uses these for internal planning reviews.
3. Audience reaction shots. Applause, engagement, group attention. More valuable in press coverage than another stage photo.
4. Candid networking. Unscripted interaction between attendees is the primary format for employer branding content.
5. Branded environment details. Table settings, stage backdrops, materials. These appear in every post-event client report.

A shot list with all five produces an archive your communications team can use for 12 months.

Which of these five does your team most often forget to request?
